title: Verification instructions are unclear after document rejection
statement: Customers who fail identity verification are being sent back to a generic onboarding page instead of a document-specific guidance page.
root_cause_hypothesis: The increase is concentrated among mobile applicants exposed to verification_reminder_v2 after their first document rejection. The reminder appears to route them to a generic onboarding page rather than document-specific requirements.
known_limitations: Product-event coverage is missing for 18 percent of affected customers.
Session replay is not connected yet, so page-level confusion is inferred from events and text evidence.

evidence.excerpt: Ich verstehe nicht, welches Dokument akzeptiert wird.
The reminder sends me back to the same generic page.

action_proposals.proposal: Create a Jira issue to route rejected-document users to a document-specific guidance page and update rejection copy.
Create a recovery task for currently blocked customers with approved support copy and callback option after 48 hours.

intervention_brief.audience_summary: Customers blocked in onboarding verification who have valid support-contact consent.
inclusion_criteria: Two verification failures in seven days
Open or unresolved verification support case
exclusion_criteria: Already contacted in the current suppression window
intervention_brief.trigger: Second failed verification attempt within seven days
intervention_brief.content_brief: Acknowledge the failed verification loop, offer document-specific guidance and a callback option, and avoid promising approval before review.
intervention_brief.control_group: Hold back eligible low-risk customers where support policy allows measurement.
consent_notes: Only service-recovery contact is allowed until consent is verified.
governance_notes: Draft task only; no autonomous customer contact.
Use approved support copy before execution.

action_proposals.proposal: Draft an audience of customers with two verification failures in seven days, valid consent, and no fraud-review flag.

intervention_brief.audience_summary: Customers stuck in onboarding verification, excluding fraud/legal review and invalid-consent records.
inclusion_criteria: Two verification failures in seven days
intervention_brief.trigger: Verification failure count reaches two within seven days
intervention_brief.content_brief: Send a guidance message that links to document-specific help and routes unresolved customers to support; do not imply automated approval.
intervention_brief.control_group: Reserve a small eligible holdout if privacy review approves measurement.
governance_notes: Privacy review required before audience export.
No sensitive attributes in inclusion criteria.

action_proposals.proposal: Recruit eight affected customers for a 30-minute validation study on document guidance clarity.

governance_checks.reason: Audience definition excludes customers without valid communication consent.
The proposal creates a behavior-derived intervention audience.
No sensitive categories are used in inclusion criteria.

title: Cancellation campaign reaches already-cancelled customers
statement: Customers who have completed cancellation are still receiving retention offers, creating complaints and avoidable support contacts.
root_cause_hypothesis: The retention journey appears to lag cancellation status updates by one batch cycle, so cancelled customers remain eligible for one additional send.
known_limitations: Campaign platform export includes send status but not final suppression reason.

evidence.excerpt: Ich habe bereits gekuendigt. Warum bekomme ich weiter Werbung?

action_proposals.proposal: Block activation until cancellation status is available as a hard suppression rule.

intervention_brief.audience_summary: Suppression-first draft for retention audiences affected by completed cancellation events.
inclusion_criteria: Cancellation completed or cancellation signal present
intervention_brief.trigger: Cancellation status changes before next retention send
intervention_brief.content_brief: Do not send a customer message; update suppression logic and record affected customers for closure review.
intervention_brief.control_group: No holdout for suppression of ineligible customers.
consent_notes: Consent cannot override a completed cancellation suppression rule.
governance_notes: Blocked until policy owner approves suppression criteria.
CLARA produces a draft; campaign platform executes after approval.

action_proposals.proposal: Create a data sync issue to reduce cancellation-status propagation delay below 15 minutes.

governance_checks.reason: Some affected profiles have no valid marketing consent after cancellation.
The action modifies eligibility for post-cancellation communication.
